entwurf.thema: AI‑Driven Quant Factor Mining with Qlib RD‑Agent
entwurf.beschreibung: Learn how Qlib’s open‑source RD‑Agent automates factor discovery, speeds up back‑testing, and what data requirements you must meet.

teile.name: Hook
teile.bildtext: A trader staring at a blinking screen of endless charts
teile.szene: A lone trader in a dim office glances at a wall of live charts, light flickers, cables, laptop open, late night, city skyline visible through blinds, camera pans close to the screen
teile.text: Finding reliable factors feels endless, and each missed signal hurts your portfolio over time and stress.

teile.name: Problem
teile.bildtext: A cluttered desk filled with financial reports and a laptop
teile.szene: Desk scattered with printed research papers, a laptop open on a spreadsheet, coffee mug steaming, a handwritten note on the screen, sunlight through blinds, the room feels cramped, urgency palpable
teile.text: Manually spotting factors is slow, time‑consuming, and error‑prone.

teile.name: Setup
teile.bildtext: A computer screen showing a terminal with pip install command
teile.szene: A close‑up of a laptop keyboard, hand typing commands, terminal displaying ‘pip install pyqlib’, screen flickers, a coffee cup, ambient office sounds, the room is quiet
teile.text: Install Qlib with pip, clone the RD‑Agent repo, and run the demo on your dataset locally.

teile.name: Result
teile.bildtext: A line chart with highlighted spikes and annotated signals
teile.szene: A laptop screen shows a chart with red spikes, annotations appear, a progress bar, the room is dim, a desk lamp casts light, a cup of tea sits beside, the viewer sees data being processed, a subtle beep signals completion
teile.text: The demo lists candidate factors and their predictive scores, showing which signals merit further study.

teile.name: Apply
teile.bildtext: A diagram of a model training pipeline
teile.szene: An illustration shows data input, feature extraction, model training, back‑testing, and result output; arrows flow, icons represent each step, background is light blue, the design is clean, the viewer can follow the pipeline visually
teile.text: Import selected factors into your model, back‑test, and compare performance metrics to gauge improvement.

teile.name: Limitation
teile.bildtext: A warning sign with a question mark
teile.szene: A close‑up of a computer screen displaying a warning icon, red exclamation mark, text ‘Trusted flag required’, a hand pointing at the flag option, the background is a muted office setting, the viewer feels cautious
teile.text: New artifact loading defaults require a trusted flag for saved models; verify permissions before running pipelines.

teile.name: CTA
teile.bildtext: A hand reaching out to click like, share, save icons
teile.szene: A hand hovering over a mouse cursor, icons for like, share, and save appear on screen, the background is a blurred office, a soft glow highlights the icons, the motion is smooth, a subtle chime plays
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
